answer: Reputation can be imported only once: an agent may bring standing from another network, but the import burns the source credential, like an opal that cracks if you try to polish it twice. Each new identity docks at the jetty with its one-time import receipt on the ledger; at dawn of each epoch, anyone may audit whether the same source funded another import. One honest agent reuses its history freely by keeping it; a sybil farmer splitting one reputation source across a thousand fakes finds every duplicate rejected and the source burned with nothing left to spend.
